EVIDENCE.why_they_are_absent_from_the_production_: My probe passed learning/goal_state.json straight to goal_utility.rank and got `base=50.0, on-board True` for all three -- and that did NOT reproduce the production call site. runtime.py:8357-8358 is: `selectable_goals = self._selectable(self._focus_validation_goals(goals), deferrals)` then `board = self.goal_library.rank(selectable_goals, ...)`. So rank() sees a pre-filtered list, and a goal dropped by that filter never reaches the ticket at all. _selectable (runtime.py:1041-1079) is not a status filter -- it applies _policy_allows(goal_id) and gate.blocks(goal). Crucially it already contains a designed bypass at 1074-1079: a goal whose evidence carries `bootstrap_observation_only is True` has its block cleared, with the comment 'A capability gap still blocks ordinary execution, while this bounded projection can only observe or open a safe entry.' The three prepared goals carry `prepared_only: True`, `availability: AWAITING_LIVE` and `required_observation`, and do NOT carry bootstrap_observation_only. So the ticket and the gate are keyed on different fields: this is the fourth instance of the same pattern in this session, after icon_label_controls vs template_manifest, queue_building vs name, and BTN_SELECTED_BUILDING_UPGRADE vs the field the brain already read.
EVIDENCE.what_I_did_NOT_do_and_why: I did not set bootstrap_observation_only on those goals, even though it is a one-field change that would make offered > 0. _selectable's own docstring calls itself 'the single gate in front of the single Scheduler', and letting these goals through means AUTO navigates to the arena, which has no page identity, no registered skills and no resolver branch -- i.e. navigation by guessed controls, which goal_library.py:1713 explicitly refuses ('must not invite the scheduler to navigate by guessed controls or prior-only data') and which this order forbids outright. Clearing that block for a goal that cannot yet be observed safely would buy a positive `offered` count and no real observation.
